_comment: Instance data for core/scripts/ledger-reconcile.py. The session start runs it --cached: the previous run's brief result is printed (silent when clean) and the next run starts in the background. The ledgers listed here are the hand-kept detail lists whose `- [ ]` / `- [x]` entries may carry `check: <read-only command>` (exit 0 = done) or `check: none — <why not machine-checkable>`. Each run names entries whose checkbox disagrees with their check, checks refused or unanswered, and open entries dated on/after ratchet_since that name no check. No file = nothing registered, nothing checked.
_fields: ledgers: paths relative to the brain root · ratchet_since: YYYY-MM-DD — older entries without a check are left alone, newer ones are named until they carry one · timeout_s: per check (default 5) · budget_s: the whole run (default 30); a check starts only while its full timeout still fits, the rest is 'not run this time', never done · allowed: optional list of command prefixes a check part may start with — REPLACES the script's read-only default list (test, grep, ls, wc, head, tail, cat, diff, git log/show/grep/rev-parse/ls-files/cat-file/merge-base/diff/status); any shell control character besides &&, || and | (; & < > ( ) $ backtick braces newline) and writing options (--output, --ext-diff, -O) always refuse the check
